political_stances.topic: DARPA生物技术办公室的使命与合成生物学定位
political_stances.stance_content: 「At BTO, we think about doing things with biology, and we think about operating within the context of biology... we operate on the scale of the individual, the warfighter, and we operate on the scale of the system which, to a large extent, is our planet or potentially even in space.」——称BTO的首要使命是「创造并预防战略突袭，无论是工程设计的还是自然发生的」

political_stances.topic: 人工智能/机器学习在生物学中的应用（任内优先事项）
political_stances.stance_content: 「We're critically, comprehensively, and quickly evaluating where AI and ML can have a discrete impact on biology.」同时警告「Unlike microchips or airplanes, biology is one of those beautiful things that can make more of itself. So you have to be careful about how you think about what AI and ML does to and with biology.」——将AI/ML应用于生物学与太空生物学列为任期两大优先方向
「Humans cannot exist in space without taking biology into account and for a long period of time without doing things with biology on station up in orbit.」——将长期太空驻留中的生物保障问题称为需要「两个奇迹」的『DARPA-hard』难题

political_stances.topic: 高风险科研项目的失败容忍观
political_stances.stance_content: 「Half of the projects we fund may fail, but there'll be enormous learnings. And the other half will be a raging success and you'll get things like GPS technology, the Internet, and mRNA vaccines. I don't think that's a bad tradeoff.」

political_stances.topic: 政府资金与风险投资/产业的协同
political_stances.stance_content: 「I want to point out to the VC funders of the world, to all the other funding organizations, and all the other startups and academics that we should work this together because it's always been a continuum of funding and development. My job will be to make sure that we socialize with the downstream parts of the funding community and the industrial community in order to mature the technology we need for our mission.」

biography_summary: 迈克尔·科里斯（Michael Koeris），博士，现任美国国防高级研究计划局（DARPA）生物技术办公室主任，2024年4月上任，领导该办公室在自主科学、医学与生物监测方向的先进能力研发，任内优先推进人工智能/机器学习与生物学结合及太空生物技术。他拥有波士顿大学生物医学工程博士学位与柏林自由大学生物化学及生物物理学学士、硕士学位，博士期间在詹姆斯·柯林斯实验室研究细菌抗生素杀伤机制，并与蒂莫西·卢联合创办Novophage（后更名Sample6），转向噬菌体示踪的食品病原体检测；Sample6获《福布斯》2017年25大最热门农业科技初创企业称号，其DETECT平台资产同年被IEH实验室收购。他还联合创办Corvium（2023年被收购），曾在Flagship Ventures与The Venture Collective从事风险投资，并在NIH RADx计划任投资组合执行官协助新冠检测研发。2020年起任凯克研究生院生物工艺学教授、Amgen生物工艺中心成员。持有专利十余项，任Addgene董事，曾当选NAI院士与AIMBE 2026届Fellow。
